proposed_capability: Scoped MoonWake /sixth-gear: convert agent-repeated household portrait handoffs into deterministic repository policy. Immediately rotate away from a verified sleeping, recharging or away selected Sim to the next awake member in fixed observed portrait order, even with zero chore assignments. After a verified needs-review completion, rotate to the next awake member; reobserve selected identity and per-Sim motives before any action. Preserve game-native authority.
player_save_control_impact: Pure, bounded selection advice from verified fixed household roster and same-capture identities. No autonomous clicker, OS setting changes, EA Connect, save edits, queue rewrites, background polling or blanket learning consent. Player input and reserved Sims always protected, and each real game effect still requires exact patch, native admission or explicit approved host-lab control.
expected_outcome: For selected ASLEEP/RECHARGING/AWAY, emit first next AWAKE portrait in roster order even when tasks list empty and regardless of target's low needs; one-pass wrap, no self-selection or blank-target fallthrough. Optional independently evidenced completed per-Sim needs review advances again. The next capture rebinds selected Sim and needs through existing host needs owner. Register the known deterministic routine in mechanics coverage as SOURCE_PRESENT, leave actual EA native effect unproven. Preserve PR #229's output and backward-compatible task allocation.
negative_tests: No queued chore still emits handoff from a verified sleeper to next awake Sim
Critical-hunger awake target remains eligible for attention, not rejected by income/welfare floor
Stable ordered portrait order including wrap and skipped asleep/away/unknown/reserved actors
No rotation for selected awake unless exact current-capture completed review proof
Unknown/changed roster, mismatched review proof, active player, selected outside roster must fail closed
Single-Sim and all-asleep household never self-select or spin
Preserve sleeping Sim recovery, player queue, selected needs and original work allocator unchanged
No game effect or completion claim from offline source code or CI
rollback_path: Revert isolated dependent PR and additions to household-economy policy/registry/tests; preserve the earlier PR #229 behavior as historical evidence, with no local user save or Windows changes.
unresolved_unknowns: Local exact Sims patch EA native portrait selection source/interaction ID not accessible to connected GitHub runtime
No locally installed game actor selection/needs readback or true clickable portrait proof from provider-side code
The visible MoonWake stage walker cannot execute on user's Windows host through GitHub tools

decision_rationale: P141 compared redoing a host portrait clicker (reject, game-native-only authority), machine-learning-only implicit pattern discovery (reject as nondeterministic), generic new household scheduler (reject owner duplication), and extending existing verified household_economy + host_stack PR #229 with a bounded independent attention-rotation rule (select). P95 models fixed-roster next index and evidence-bound review progression; P82 tests no-task sleep, welfare-first target, wrap, player sovereignty and stale proof; P08 actual EA-native effect unverified; P07/P124 reuse established owners and register repeatable rule for all clones.
